entries.scope: Bounded structural coverage of the complete original -려무나/-으려무나 owners: canonical 으려무나; short form after vowel or ㄹ verb stems, full form after other codas; verb/adjective homonyms assessed separately. All eight complete original example groups have independently preauthored lexical, lemma-role, morpheme and rule targets. The original 25 cases retain16required/9forbidden paths, including irregular allomorphs, auxiliary alternatives and known bare copula/답다 boundaries. Eight original novel byte occurrences have separately recorded post-runtime lexical proposals; three derived-class cases retain the actual nominal-plus-답다 representation. Complete Native fields, homonyms, dialogue, original source and annotated corpus bytes and old candidate order remain preserved. Actual installed packages/CLI/browser and independent evidence corruption checks passed. This disposition certifies this finite structural scope only.
entries.remaining: Unlisted past, modal/honorific prefinals and outer particles retain Unknown compatibility. Wider interactions, contextual lexical/sense choice, the very low-register social conditions, pragmatic command/permission function and independent Korean review remain open. Eight novel proposals were authored after runtime observation; eleven other raw novel hypotheses remain unjudged. No contextual gold, global candidate bans, all-Korean completeness or precision estimate is claimed.
